patch.value: Measure all executable pm-starter TypeScript and statement coverage

The current release coverage gate reports 100% lines, branches and functions over three files, while the docstring gate sees six authored TypeScript files. Node V8 coverage does not report statements separately, so 100/100/100/100 cannot be claimed. Executable scripts/main-invocation.ts, scripts/prepare-merge-driver.ts and scripts/verify-release-publish-attestation.ts need explicit inventory and direct behavior coverage, with any type-only exclusion justified.

Inventory all six authored executable TypeScript source files and prove which the current gate omits; coverage gate fails when any authored executable source is unmeasured; measure statements lines branches functions at 100% per included file with real tests; retain docstring and release gate parity without artificial exclusions or duplicated tests.

message: Track measured coverage gap separately from passing configured gate
